item.text:
Audited all 59 Roman verses against the Urdu in [allah-allah-kar.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/0bb4af4bb17c4e5ea6c18ba8d49268d8/src/data/lyrics/allah-allah-kar.md). Corrected phonetic spellings, izafat, and refrain punctuation, and restored `Takallum` in the penultimate verse. The Urdu text and other metadata are unchanged.

Three occurrences of `قد` are rendered as `qad` as written. The reading `aaye` for `اے` in the Madine verse was retained from the existing Roman based on context. These readings remain open for editorial sign-off.
